response.rationale: Options C and D are equivalent to the top-ranked leaf 'Nevoid Basal Cell Carcinoma Syndrome (Gorlin Syndrome)' with the highest support and confidence scores. Since both C and D are equivalent to the same leaf and have identical support/confidence, their relative order is arbitrary but must be distinct. Options A and B are unmatched and therefore ranked lower. Among unmatched options, their relative order is arbitrary.
